name: Open the core learning workflow
description: Verifies the main dashboard can enter a semester-aware AI Teacher workflow.
steps: Open the Civil Engineering Study OS
expected: Semester 1 is selected and the AI Teacher workspace is visible.

name: Upload, analyze and practice a college question bank
description: Verifies a readable college question bank can be stored, classified and turned into practice questions without inventing source content.
steps: Choose Question Bank and upload a small text-readable PDF
expected: The question bank appears with its College Material source label, analysis counts are visible, and extracted practice questions show source answers only when the source contains them.

name: Search the source-traceable knowledge base
description: Verifies extracted college material can be searched and returned with ranked relevance, hierarchy context and source version metadata.
steps: Select Semester 1 and search for a topic from an uploaded college material
Inspect the returned source version and hierarchy
expected: Matching material is ranked by relevance and displayed with subject, source label, version metadata and Semester → Subject → Unit → Topic context.

name: Browse the Semester → Subject → Unit → Topic knowledge hierarchy
description: Verifies the Knowledge Base can expose a structured hierarchy from indexed college material without treating inferred topics as official facts.
steps: Select the hierarchy view for Semester 1
Inspect a topic source and version
expected: A Semester → Subject → Unit → Topic tree is visible and each topic retains a source/version reference.

name: Practice and score MCQs with adaptive revision
description: Verifies exam practice produces a score and offers a weak-area revision plan.
expected: A score is visible and an adaptive revision plan shows prioritized actions with topics and time estimates.

name: Schedule and review a topic with spaced repetition
description: Verifies a student can add a topic, review it with a quality rating, and receive a future review date.
steps: Select a Semester 1 subject and enter a topic
Select Good when the topic is due
expected: The topic moves from due now to a scheduled future review and shows a review interval.

name: Run a deterministic Civil Engineering calculator
description: Verifies deterministic engineering calculations run without AI hallucination risk.
expected: A numeric converted result is shown and identified as deterministic calculator output.

name: Show an AI failure safely on mobile
description: Verifies an injected AI failure is visible and does not silently change the workspace.
expected: A visible error message appears and the current workspace remains usable.

name: Run and validate a deterministic numerical solution
description: Verifies a civil engineering stress calculation returns a deterministic formula, numeric result, units and verification note.
steps: Enter force 10000 and area 2 using SI units
expected: A verified numerical result shows Stress = Force / Area, the calculated value 5000 and a unit/verification note.

name: Run Exam System 2.0 theory evaluation and mock workflow
description: Verifies Exam 2.0 can evaluate a theory answer and run a question-by-question mock.
steps: Enter a theory question and answer
expected: Theory score/feedback and mock score/review are visible.

name: Practice Viva 2.0 one question at a time with evaluation and follow-up
description: Verifies the Viva 2.0 workflow can generate one question, evaluate a student answer and present a follow-up question without claiming college-specific grading rules.
steps: Review score, feedback and follow-up question
expected: One question is shown at a time, evaluation is visible on a 0-10 scale, and a follow-up question is available. Low scores are added to the local weak-topic tracker.

name: Connect the Local AI workspace to Ollama
description: Verifies the Local AI workspace exposes browser-to-Ollama configuration and keeps local AI separate from the online backend.
steps: Inspect the Ollama URL and model controls
Inspect the local connection status and Windows setup note
expected: The Local AI workspace shows an Ollama URL field, model field, connection control, local status area and privacy/setup guidance.

name: Analyze recorded lab observations without inventing measurements
description: Verifies recorded numeric observations are summarized deterministically and the lab workflow distinguishes measured data from AI-generated report structure.
expected: Count, average, minimum, maximum and spread are shown, with a note that the values came from the student.

name: Use Adaptive Learning 2.0 to identify the next study action
description: Verifies completed MCQ performance feeds a local adaptive profile and exposes a prioritized next study action without treating it as the official college syllabus.
steps: Generate and submit an MCQ set
Inspect readiness, weak areas and recommended minutes
expected: Adaptive Learning shows recorded performance, a next study action, topic-level weak areas when detected, and a path to an AI revision plan grounded in the selected semester.

name: Analyze a civil drawing with Drawing & Diagram AI
description: Verifies a student can select a civil drawing image, choose an explanation mode and request an image-aware learning result with clear verification limits.
steps: Review the visual explanation and verification note
expected: The drawing workspace accepts an image, sends it for analysis and shows a beginner-friendly result with a warning that dimensions, standards and safety must be verified.

name: Run advanced civil quantity calculators
description: Verifies deterministic advanced quantity calculators return transparent estimates with stated engineering assumptions.
steps: Select Steel Weight and enter diameter 12 mm and length 10 m
Select Cement Bags Estimate and enter volume 1 m³ with mix ratio 1,2,4
expected: Deterministic results are displayed with units and the cement estimate explicitly states its dry-volume and cement-density assumptions.

name: Use Civil Lab 3.0 to record and analyze an experiment
description: Checks the enhanced lab workspace without fabricating measurements.
expected: Lab workspace records the experiment locally, shows deterministic statistics and provides report/viva actions with verification warnings.

name: Build a deterministic quantity takeoff and cost estimate
description: Verifies a student can add a measured quantity with a user-entered rate and receive transparent BOQ totals without invented rates.
steps: Enter PCC concrete, choose Volume, enter length 5, width 3, height 0.15, multiplier 1 and rate 6500
expected: The BOQ shows quantity 2.25 m³, the entered rate ₹6500, a calculated item amount and a grand total with separate wastage and overhead amounts.

name: Reject invalid quantity takeoff dimensions
description: Verifies invalid dimensions are blocked before an estimation item is added.
steps: Enter a negative length and a valid rate
expected: A visible validation error appears and no invalid quantity item is added.

name: Practice an AutoCAD, Revit or BIM project workflow
description: Verifies the CAD/BIM workspace exposes software tracks, skill levels, ordered learning steps and a practical civil project workflow.
steps: Review the Residential Building BIM/CAD Pack deliverables
expected: The workspace shows the selected Revit level, ordered learning steps, software-version verification guidance and a practical project deliverable checklist.

name: Track a final-year civil project
description: Verifies project stage and deliverable completion can be tracked locally.
steps: Mark report and portfolio deliverables complete
expected: The Project & Final Year Manager workspace is visible with project name, stage selector, delivery checklist and completion status.

name: Build civil internship readiness evidence
description: Verifies career readiness can be tracked using practical evidence rather than unsupported placement claims.
steps: Mark CAD/BIM and project evidence complete
expected: The target, evidence checklist and readiness percentage are visible, with a reminder to verify employer-specific requirements.

name: Verify Knowledge Graph 2.0 against stored college material
description: Verifies graph topics can link to stored college material, track mastery and be explicitly marked student-verified.
steps: Add a Semester 1 topic with a unit, prerequisite and mastery percentage
Inspect the mapped topic and source-link state
Mark the topic verified when a stored college source is linked
expected: The graph shows mastery, prerequisite health, linked college-source count and a clear student-verified state only after explicit verification.

name: Build a project evidence ledger
description: Verifies project work can be recorded as evidence entries and explicitly marked verified without claiming faculty certification.
steps: Add a drawing/model evidence entry with a note
expected: The evidence ledger shows the entry and student-verified status, and delivery readiness reflects both checklist and evidence verification.

name: Retain local study records for offline-first use
description: Verifies a locally stored revision topic survives a refresh without requiring a backend request.
steps: Add a Semester 1 topic named Offline Revision Topic
expected: Offline Revision Topic remains visible with its scheduled review state.

name: Show explicit network state and offline guidance
description: Verifies the app exposes explicit online/offline state and explains which workflows remain available without a network.
steps: Open the Civil Engineering Study OS
Inspect the network status indicator and offline-first guidance
expected: A clear network status is visible and the Offline Center identifies local workflows that remain available while online AI and server-backed features may require a connection.

name: Recover safely from malformed local study data
description: Verifies malformed local browser state does not prevent the Study OS from loading its local-first workspace.
steps: Open the Study OS with malformed saved local study data present
expected: The Study OS remains usable and the Privacy & Offline Center renders instead of crashing on malformed local data.
